title: Best Sightseeing Pair
summary: Given an array of integers representing the values of sightseeing spots, find the maximum score of a pair (i < j) where the score is calculated as the sum of the values of the spots minus their distance.
statement: Given an array of integers representing the values of sightseeing spots, find the maximum score of a pair (i < j) where the score is calculated as the sum of the values of the spots minus their distance.
constraints: At least two positive values are provided.
hints: Maintain the best left contribution while scanning j.
Update the answer with best+values[j]-j, then include values[j]+j for future pairs.
The maintained maximum considers every legal earlier i without revisiting it.
editorial: The maintained maximum considers every legal earlier i without revisiting it.
